Message's origin is determined to be in the vicinity of Arda planets One, Two and Three!''"<br />"''Prepare to destroy all three, if necessary!|An [[Imperial Navy Trooper/Legends|Imperial Navy Trooper]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="ALAWL">"[[As Long As We Live...]]"</ref>}}
'''Arda III''' was an [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]] located in the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda system]], a part of the [[Back Reach]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Ardan Cross]] connected it to the [[Feldwes system/Legends|Feldwes]] and [[Kalishik system/Legends|Kalishik systems]], and another hyperlane linked it to the [[Capella system/Legends|Capella system]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was sparsely populated.<ref name="Onslaught" />
